Wir haben die App mehrfach über Jahre genutzt und waren nie enttäuscht. Nun haben wir erneut Passbilder für den Reisepass für unsere Tochter bestellt. Diese kamen nie bei uns an. Trotz Reklamation wurden mir drei Euro statt der 15 € erstattet. Abschließend kamen hinzu, dass die Bilder in Deutschland gar nicht mehr für Ausweis Dokumente verwendet werden dürfen. Beim kompletten Bestellprozess und beim Abschluss der Bestellung ist mir kein Hinweis dieser Art so ins Auge gefallen, dass ich meine Kaufentscheidung geändert hätte. Der Support zwischen K. I. reviews.title: Do you need this?
reviews.text: After spending almost an hour trying to get a photo (by myself) that would give the app what it asked for I uploaded the photo to the app.  I almost immediately got back an approval from PhotoAid that they could use the photo. An hour later I received a photo to upload the passport renewal site.  So far, so good. Then a week after submitting the photo I received a letter from the State Department that said the photo had been “digitally altered” and please  send a physical unaltered photo (not an upload).  I contacted PhotoAid and they said they would do another photo for no charge but I would have to resubmit a new photo.  Here’s what I think…the original photo should not have been approved by PhotoAid. PhotoAid should know what digital altering they did would not be acceptable and before I start the whole, lengthy process again I should go to CVS and walk out 15 minutes later with two photos I know will be accepted and that process will be $5 less than I spent with PhotoAid.

reviews.title: Not reliable
reviews.text: I expected them to be delivered in 2-3 days and double refund when it is rejected by authorities. But delivery took 5 days and got rejected by post office as the head size of photo was smaller than it should be. I expected to get double refund as it was written on the app. However they requested an official document from the authorities which is not fair for the authorities. (they don’t need to provide official document to reject photo. They already explained me why it got rejected by showing me the expectation and compare the photos that I brought to post office) disappointing. Wasted my time.

reviews.title: Buyer Beware
reviews.text: This App is very misleading to customers. I thought I was ordering 2 passport photos since I have small children it is more difficult to get them to sit still at a store. I didn’t mind paying the $20+ dollars per photo for a piece of mind. Instead they only sent to the CVS of my choosing a passport template card that will still require me to buy passport photos. I had to email them as there in no direct line for them to basically tell me that is how they run there business. If I had known that I would have put up with the headache of going to get their pictures done somewhere else. Plus I’m out $50+ dollars for them to tell me they can’t issue me a refund. I’m reporting them to the BBB because this is a predatory practice.

reviews.title: Be weary
reviews.text: Poor customer service. Even if you select appropriate proportions per your government. They can still reject your images on the basis poor fit, quality and various other factors. App developers do not care. There’s also not a way to adjust the same photo you paid for to try to make it fit the officers approval. Only plus side, it works for USA applications because they have less criteria to be met but for countries with strict standards. Avoid, best have that agency assist you over using a low performing app with minimal features. Also to mention. If you download to your phone, printing is severely enlarged so you will also need to move images to a document to get an accurate size.
